scientific_integrity: The complete rational D_n-module is proved for n>=7 by signed Lefschetz trace and transfer-matrix formulas, relying on a fully attributed published mod-two homology concentration theorem. The earlier rank calculation is not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: No equivariant homotopy classification or orbit-space homology
Residual originality risk from unindexed general equivariant cyclic-hypergraph results
Finite checks corroborate symbolic proof and cannot certify all n
title: Dihedral homology representations of triangle-free complexes of squared cycles
